name: Mountain Post
author: brendr

sections.description:
Mountain Post is an AI-powered SEO automation platform. It discovers what your target audience is searching for, writes high-quality SEO articles, and publishes them on your website — automatically.

This plugin connects your WordPress website to your Mountain Post account. Once connected, Mountain Post can:

  • Publish new articles directly to your WordPress blog
  • Update existing articles
  • Update the content, SEO title and meta description of existing pages (Yoast SEO and Rank Math)
  • Sync categories, tags, and featured images
  • Write SEO titles and meta descriptions (compatible with Yoast SEO)

Mountain Post requires a subscription. Visit mountainpost.io to sign up.

How it works

  1. Install this plugin on your WordPress website.
  2. In Mountain Post, go to your website’s Connection tab and generate a connection key.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings → Mountain Post, paste the key, and click Connect.

That’s it — Mountain Post will now be able to publish to your website.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or later
  • HTTPS enabled on your website
  • A Mountain Post account (mountainpost.io)

External services

This plugin connects to mountainpost.io, a third-party service operated by BrendR. Specifically:

  • When you connect the plugin, it sends your site URL, WordPress username, and a generated API token to mountainpost.io to register the connection. The token only allows creating and updating posts, updating the content and SEO fields of existing pages, creating tags, and reading tags and categories — it does not grant admin access to your site.
  • During content publication, mountainpost.io instructs the plugin to download featured images from external image URLs (provided by the Mountain Post service) and attach them to posts.
  • If multilingual content is enabled, the plugin sets a mp_language cookie on site visitors to remember their language preference.

By using this plugin, you agree to the Mountain Post Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mountain-post folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Mountain Post and follow the connection instructions.
sections.faq:
Is Mountain Post free?

Mountain Post requires a subscription. You can start a free trial at mountainpost.io.

Can I disconnect later?

Yes. Go to Settings → Mountain Post and click Disconnect. This removes the stored connection token and stops Mountain Post from publishing to your website.

Does this plugin work with Yoast SEO?

Yes. When Mountain Post publishes an article, it also sets the Yoast SEO title and meta description fields.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added PATCH /wp-json/mountain-post/v1/pages/{id} endpoint for updating page content and SEO meta. Supports Yoast SEO and RankMath. All fields optional; only provided fields are updated.

1.2.0

  • Removed Application Password requirement. The plugin now connects using only a generated API token, eliminating the need for remote admin credentials. Existing installs with a stored Application Password will have it cleaned up automatically on reconnect.
  • Removed Authorization header restoration block (LiteSpeed workaround) — no longer needed since connection no longer uses Basic Auth.
  • Posts are now created with explicit post_author instead of using wp_set_current_user.

1.1.0

  • Added custom REST API endpoints authenticated via X-Mountain-Post-Token header for compatibility with LiteSpeed and other servers that strip the Authorization header.
  • Added featured image sideloading from Mountain Post-provided image URLs.
  • Added multilingual support: language switcher appended to posts, cookie-based language persistence, and query-parameter language selection (?lang=nl).
  • Added IndexNow integration for automatic URL submission to Bing after publication.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
